changelog:
Initial release of ChessGuardian skill.

- Play chess via the ChessGuardian API: start games, make moves, view or analyze positions, and get live board snapshots.
- Supports both player-vs-AI and player-vs-player modes.
- Run autoplay chess bots using Stockfish or Minimax.
- Generate and share QR codes for joining games.
- Users can watch live chess games through a browser link.
